**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The ownership package sits at the **preferred** position:

- **§ 14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right.
- **§ 14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable on creation, with a present assignment from Vendor, flow-down assignments from personnel, and further assurances.
- **§ 14.3 + § 13.2** — Vendor retains only Vendor Technology, and any Vendor Technology embedded in or needed to use a Deliverable is covered by a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence including modification and derivative works.
- **§ 14.4** — no joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument; feedback is voluntary and Customer keeps unrestricted rights. **§ 15.1** additionally bars model training on Customer Data.

Noted but not flagged: the Customer Data definition (§ 1.3) excludes anonymized, non-linkable operational telemetry, and the Deliverable definition (§ 1.4) excludes unaided-memory know-how — both customary carve-outs that do not affect the material terms.
